problem_statement: Persistent water and energy shortages disrupt economic activity and production.
claim: The World Bank describes water and energy shortages as constraints on Iranian economic activity and production.
affected_group: Businesses, producers and households in Iran
source_title: Islamic Republic of Iran — World Bank country overview
excerpt: The country overview identifies growing water and energy shortages as disruptions to economic activity, alongside sanctions and structural pressures.

problem_statement: Small firms face pressure from inflation, undercapitalized banks and currency depreciation.
claim: The World Bank's October 2026 Macro Poverty Outlook describes inflation, undercapitalized banks and currency depreciation as constraints on investment and production.
source_title: Iran, Islamic Republic — Macro Poverty Outlook, October 2026
excerpt: The report identifies persistent energy shortages, inflation, undercapitalized banks and currency depreciation among constraints on investment and production.

problem_statement: Young people face limited employment opportunities and unstable pathways into work.
claim: Iran Open Data reports high youth unemployment and describes young people entering adulthood with constrained job opportunities.
source_title: Iran’s Gen Z faces 32% youth unemployment, prolonged internet blackout
excerpt: The article discusses youth unemployment and limited opportunities for young people, including people whose small online businesses were disrupted.

problem_statement: SMEs encounter financial, institutional, technological and market barriers.
claim: A 2025 Iranian policy study identifies financial limitations and inflation, fragmented bureaucracy, technology and training gaps, and market constraints affecting SME policy implementation.
source_title: Analysis of the Implementation Gap in SME Business Environment Policies in Iran
excerpt: The study categorizes implementation gaps across economic, institutional, technological and market dimensions.

problem_statement: Iranian small businesses face sales-growth constraints linked to sanctions and limited external finance.
claim: A 2026 Journal of Policy Modeling study reports that sanctions harm sales growth in Iranian small businesses and that financing and technology access matter.
source_title: Beyond sanctions: Unpacking growth generators for Iranian small business
excerpt: The study examines sanctions and sales growth, reporting that access to external financing, technology and managerial education are associated with growth outcomes.

problem_statement: Macroeconomic volatility creates planning uncertainty for firms and households.
claim: World Bank indicators show negative GDP growth and high consumer price inflation for Iran in 2025.
source_title: Iran, Islamic Rep. — World Bank Data
excerpt: The World Bank data page lists 2025 GDP growth and consumer price inflation indicators for Iran.

problem_statement: Water scarcity, drought and environmental degradation threaten agricultural productivity and rural livelihoods.
claim: The BTI 2026 Iran report describes drought, water scarcity, soil erosion and biodiversity loss, with effects on agriculture and food security.
affected_group: Farmers, rural workers and food producers
source_title: BTI 2026 Iran Country Report
excerpt: The report links environmental pressures to agriculture, food security and employment opportunities.

problem_statement: Women face structural barriers to labor-force participation and employment.
claim: A World Bank report describes low female labor-force participation and higher unemployment among women in Iran.
source_title: World Bank document on Iran's labor market and employment
excerpt: The report discusses high unemployment, especially among youth, and low female labor-force participation.

problem_statement: Repeated internet shutdowns disrupt women-led and home-based digital businesses.
claim: A Femena report documents how internet shutdowns affect online microbusinesses and women's livelihoods in Iran.
affected_group: Women-led online microbusinesses and home-based sellers
source_title: From War to Protests: Recurrent Internet Shutdowns and the Gradual Displacement of Women from the Labor Market
excerpt: The report describes repeated connectivity disruptions affecting online businesses, especially small and women-led enterprises.

problem_statement: Internet blackouts interrupt income from online classes and small home businesses.
claim: RFE/RL reports cases of Iranian women whose online teaching and home businesses lost access to customers during internet blackouts.
affected_group: Online instructors and women operating home businesses
source_title: Women Bear The Brunt Of Iran's Internet Blackout As 'Parallel Labor Market' Collapses
excerpt: The report describes an online yoga instructor unable to hold classes and other women whose livelihoods depended on internet access.

problem_statement: Small online retailers and startups lose access to customers and external digital tools during connectivity shutdowns.
claim: Iran International reports that prolonged internet shutdowns cut off e-commerce retailers and freelance service providers from customers and global tools.
source_title: Iran's digital economy battered by prolonged blackout
excerpt: The report describes loss of access to customers, platforms and backend systems during the prolonged internet shutdown.

problem_statement: Freelancers and small digital firms lose contracts, income and the ability to deliver services during outages.
claim: Iran International reports freelancers and small businesses describing lost income, disrupted projects and inability to maintain customer service during internet outages.
source_title: Iran blackout cripples freelancer, small business incomes
excerpt: The article describes freelancers losing access to projects and small digital enterprises struggling with sales, customer communication and after-sales service.

problem_statement: Social-commerce sellers face sudden loss of storefronts, customer communication and sales when platforms become inaccessible.
claim: Iran International reports that Instagram-based shops and other online sellers experienced major sales disruption during a nationwide blackout.
source_title: No clicks, no revenue: Iran's blackout wipes out online businesses
excerpt: The report describes businesses relying on Instagram, Telegram and WhatsApp as storefronts and losing access to sales and customers during the blackout.

problem_statement: Freelancers lose access to foreign contracts and payments when international connectivity is disrupted.
claim: Iran International reports that freelancers lost foreign contracts and income during an internet shutdown.
domain: remote work and exports of services
source_title: Internet shutdown chokes off one of the last lifelines for young Iranians
excerpt: The report describes digital workers losing access to projects and payment-related opportunities during connectivity restrictions.

problem_statement: Unreliable connectivity undermines customer trust and online sales for small sellers.
claim: The National reports that inconsistent internet access disrupted online trade and customer trust for small sellers relying on social platforms.
source_title: View from Tehran: Internet shutdown deepens economic pain as uncertainty drags on
excerpt: The article describes online businesses relying on Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram facing severe losses and inconsistent connectivity.

problem_statement: High agricultural input costs and low reservoir levels can constrain planting decisions and irrigation.
claim: FAO's November 2026 Iran brief reports that fertilizer and seed costs may discourage planting and low reservoir levels could restrict irrigation in producing provinces.
source_title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Iran — 10 November 2026
excerpt: The brief notes high input costs and low reservoir levels as potential constraints on planting and early crop development.

problem_statement: Pistachio growers need reliable technical knowledge to manage drought, water scarcity and contamination risks.
claim: FAO documents a pistachio farmer's need for practical technical knowledge and training under drought and water-scarcity conditions.
source_title: Water scarcity and the pistachio predicament
excerpt: The FAO story describes heat, water scarcity and contamination as risks to pistachio production and highlights the importance of technical knowledge and training.

problem_statement: Drought-related production shortfalls and rising input costs increase uncertainty for cereal farmers and food supply chains.
claim: FAO's June 2026 country brief reports below-average cereal production in 2025 and rising production costs, while noting supply-chain concerns.
affected_group: Farmers, grain traders and food supply-chain businesses
source_title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief — Iran, 10 June 2026
excerpt: The brief estimates 2025 cereal production below the five-year average and discusses higher input costs and possible supply-chain disruptions.

problem_statement: Conflict-related disruptions to mobility, supply chains and consumer activity threaten informal workers and small enterprises.
claim: UNDP's March 2026 analysis warns that transport interruptions, supply-chain and payment disruptions can affect small enterprises and informal livelihoods.
affected_group: Informal workers, small enterprises and self-employed people
source_title: Military escalation threatens human and economic development gains across Iran, UNDP analysis warns
excerpt: The UNDP release describes risks to livelihoods from market instability, temporary business closures, mobility restrictions and disrupted supply chains.

problem_statement: Damage to commercial facilities and disruption to banking and telecommunications interrupt local business income flows.
claim: A UN humanitarian update reports damage to commercial and food-production facilities and identifies disruptions to essential services and markets.
affected_group: Local businesses, food producers and affected communities
source_title: Iran Humanitarian Update Issue No. 02
excerpt: The update describes damage to markets and food-related production and storage facilities, affecting access to essential goods in several provinces.
